notes.title: A fast patch for the game's movement controls
notes.notes: A quick game movement controls fix, W and S are move the car up and down , A and D are for right and left

notes.title: 4 More months until the game actual release date!!!!!
notes.notes:
+ Everything i have promised in the game description and maybe a tad bit more
I will try my best to meet what i have promised, so as to create an amazing experience for both you guys and myself as well , because i love the GTA cop chase mechanic and the cinematic vibe it gives the player. Therefore, i have wanted to make a game like this as a love letter to the franchise. 
Thanks for paying attention to this note. Have a nice day guys!
